messages:
Ava - CSM: kicking off BrightPath onboarding. Hi team — Sam from BrightPath just signed the onboarding SOW. Goal: enable search + summarization by end of Q1. Quick alignment on stakeholders, success criteria, and a 7-day playbook? I'll add calendar invites after we agree. Ping if you need anything before the call. @Carlos @Mira @Jules

Sam Patel (BrightPath): excited to get started. Primary KPIs: time-to-first-meaningful-answer < 2s, 80% satisfaction in week 1 tests. We can provide test data and SSO details. FYI, security team needs SOC2 scoping doc.

Carlos - Solutions Eng: got it. Can you drop sample data link and the IdP metadata? I’ll run a quick model sizing. Also, what's expected concurrency? 

Sam Patel (BrightPath): concurrency is low initially, ~5-10 rps, spikes to 50 during demos. Data link: https://files.brightpath.test/onboard-sample (internal). IdP metadata will come from their Okta admin, I'll share by EOD.

Mira - PM: for success criteria, propose: 1) Integration completed w/ SSO and ingest, 2) baseline gen latency < 2s at expected load, 3) test prompt set pass rate >=80%. Timeline: Day 0 intake, Day 1 SSO + ingest, Day 2 model tuning, Day 3 acceptance tests, Day 4 iterate, Day 5 go/no-go. Thoughts?

Jules - Onboard Eng: that timeline is tight but doable. I'll prep the ingest pipeline template. Quick snippet for the config we’ll use:
```
ingest:
  source: s3
  format: jsonl
  batch_size: 100
  dedupe: true
```
I'll also need sample prompts and labels.

Ava - CSM: @Sam can you confirm who's the technical point of contact at BrightPath? Also, are there regulatory constraints we should flag? I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow morning if that works.

Sam Patel (BrightPath): TPOC is Priya Kumar (pri@brightpath.com). No special regs beyond SOC2. Morning works — prefer 9:30 PT.

Carlos - Solutions Eng: noted. I'll create a tech intake doc and paste the checklist here by noon. 

deploy-bot: Workspace 'brightpath-onboard' created by Ava. Access: https://redwood.app/w/brightpath-onboard

Ava - CSM: Action items — (1) Sam to share IdP metadata + sample data link (Sam) (2) Carlos to post tech intake + sizing (Carlos) (3) Jules to prep ingest template + quickstart steps (Jules) (4) Mira to own acceptance criteria doc (Mira). I'll send calendar invite for 9:30 PT tomorrow. 

Sam Patel (BrightPath): Will share IdP + data by EOD. :thumbsup:

Jules - Onboard Eng: I'll also add a short runbook for ramping concurrency — will post here.

Mira - PM: adding acceptance criteria doc to the workspace. Link: https://redwood.app/w/brightpath-onboard/docs/acceptance

Ava - CSM: Perfect — moving to scheduling. Thanks all. :party_parrot:

Carlos - Solutions Eng: quick question — do we want to use dedicated for predictable latency or start hosted and then flip? Cost estimates may sway them.

Sam Patel (BrightPath): Prefer hosted initially; we can revisit dedicated once live. Budget sensitivity noted.

Ava - CSM: Noted. We'll prepare both options in the intake doc. Ok closing thread for now — will update when invite is sent.
